stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The workers strike for safer conditions.
items.sentenceZh: 工人们为争取更安全的条件而罢工。
items.scene: Exactly five adult workers stand together outside a closed factory gate in an orderly peaceful strike. They hold blank placards without writing, while set-down work helmets and an idle entrance show that labor has stopped. No police, conflict, raised fists or political symbols.
items.altText: 五名工人在关闭的工厂门外和平停工，举着无字标牌。

items.sentenceEn: The evening sky glows above the quiet lake.
items.sentenceZh: 傍晚的天空在宁静湖面上方泛着光。
items.scene: A broad evening sky fills most of the composition above a narrow quiet lake and low distant hills. High clouds shift from blue to gold and soft pink, with their reflection in the water reinforcing the sky as the main subject. No people or buildings.
items.altText: 广阔的金粉色傍晚天空占据画面上方，倒映在狭长湖面。

items.sentenceEn: The healed bird returns to freedom.
items.sentenceZh: 康复的鸟儿重获自由。
items.scene: At the edge of a wide meadow, one adult wildlife rehabilitator opens both hands as one healthy hawk lifts away into open air. An empty transport crate with its door open rests behind the adult, clearly showing release into freedom rather than loss or escape.
items.altText: 野生动物救助员张开双手，一只康复的鹰从敞开的运输箱旁飞向开阔天空。

items.sentenceEn: After three checks, she is absolutely certain of the route.
items.sentenceZh: 经过三次核对，她对路线绝对确定。
items.scene: An adult navigator at a mountain shelter compares a paper map, a compass and a trail landmark visible through the window. All three independently indicate the same direction, and she points decisively toward that route with a calm completely certain expression. No readable labels.
items.altText: 导航员用地图、指南针和窗外地标三重核对后，笃定地指向同一方向。

items.sentenceEn: The plane rises above the runway.
items.sentenceZh: 飞机升到跑道上方。
items.scene: One unbranded passenger plane has just lifted above a long airport runway, landing gear still beginning to retract. The low side view clearly separates the aircraft from the runway and shows upward movement. No other aircraft, airline marks or readable signs.
items.altText: 一架无标志客机刚从跑道升空，起落架正在收起。

items.sentenceEn: Nobody is waiting at the small station.
items.sentenceZh: 小车站里没有人在等候。
items.scene: A small rural train platform is visibly ready for passengers but completely empty: bare benches, an open shelter, a silent clock without readable numbers and a train track stretching away. The entire platform and shelter are visible so the absence of people is unmistakable.
items.altText: 乡间小站的站台、长椅和候车棚完全空着，没有任何人。

items.sentenceEn: The climbers achieve their goal at the summit.
items.sentenceZh: 登山者在山顶实现了目标。
items.scene: Exactly two adult climbers step together onto a clear mountain summit after a visible winding ascent. They touch hands in quiet celebration beside a simple cairn while the long trail and lower valley behind them show the difficult goal they have achieved. No flags or text.
items.altText: 两名登山者沿漫长山路抵达峰顶，在石堆旁击掌庆祝实现目标。

items.sentenceEn: The students examine an unfamiliar object.
items.sentenceZh: 学生们观察一个陌生物体。
items.scene: Exactly three adult students gather around one unfamiliar but safe solid object on a plain table: a smooth asymmetrical metal form with holes and ridges. One views it closely, one measures it with calipers and one sketches its outline on blank paper, emphasizing the object itself.
items.altText: 三名学生围绕桌上一个有孔洞和棱脊的陌生金属物体进行观察测量。

items.sentenceEn: Her patient attitude helps solve the difficult repair.
items.sentenceZh: 她耐心的态度有助于解决棘手的维修问题。
items.scene: An adult bicycle mechanic faces a difficult tangled gear repair with a patient positive attitude. She sits steadily, studies the mechanism and calmly tries a careful adjustment while an adult apprentice watches and relaxes, encouraged by her expression and posture. No readable text.
items.altText: 自行车技师面对棘手齿轮故障仍神情耐心、姿态沉稳，认真尝试调整。

items.sentenceEn: Their labor builds the stone irrigation channel.
items.sentenceZh: 他们的劳动修建了石砌灌溉渠。
items.scene: Exactly four adult workers perform coordinated physical labor to build a stone irrigation channel: one carries a stone, one places mortar, one positions a stone and one levels the finished edge. A completed section behind and unfinished section ahead show the result of their labor. Safe tools and postures.
items.altText: 四名工人分工搬石、抹灰、砌石和找平，共同修建灌溉渠。

items.sentenceEn: The botanists refer to a field guide.
items.sentenceZh: 植物学家们参考野外指南。
items.scene: Exactly two adult botanists kneel beside an unfamiliar flowering plant and refer to an open field guide together. One compares the plant's leaf shape with clear botanical drawings on the page while the other gently points between the real leaf and matching drawing. No readable words.
items.altText: 两名植物学家把真实植物叶形与野外指南中的图画相互对照。

items.sentenceEn: The model explains the concept of a shared courtyard.
items.sentenceZh: 模型说明了共享庭院的概念。
items.scene: An adult architect presents a simple scale model that expresses one clear concept: four small homes face inward around a single shared green courtyard. Two adult residents look from the model to a corresponding rough spatial sketch made only of shapes, understanding the organizing idea. No readable labels.
items.altText: 建筑师用四栋住宅围绕同一绿地的模型解释共享庭院概念。

items.sentenceEn: The architect shows the client two home designs.
items.sentenceZh: 建筑师向客户展示两种住宅设计。
items.scene: At an architecture studio table, one adult architect presents exactly two distinct small home models to one adult client. The client studies both models and points to a preferred accessible entrance while the architect listens and takes notes on blank paper, showing a professional client relationship.
items.altText: 建筑师向一名客户展示两座住宅模型，客户指出偏好的无障碍入口。

items.sentenceEn: The powerful winch lifts the heavy log.
items.sentenceZh: 强力绞盘吊起沉重的原木。
items.scene: A compact mechanical winch anchored to a work vehicle steadily lifts one massive fallen log from muddy ground. One adult forestry worker operates it from a safe distance, and the taut cable plus deep empty groove beneath the rising log make the machine's powerful force clear. No logos.
items.altText: 一台紧绷钢缆的机械绞盘把沉重原木从泥地上稳稳吊起。

items.sentenceEn: The final wooden piece is a perfect fit.
items.sentenceZh: 最后一块木片完美契合。
items.scene: An adult craftsperson lowers one final precisely shaped wooden inlay into the only matching space in an intricate tabletop pattern. The piece fits flush with no gaps while several visibly wrong spare shapes remain set aside, making a perfect fit unmistakable.
items.altText: 工匠把最后一块木制镶片嵌入唯一吻合的空位，边缘严丝合缝。

items.sentenceEn: Nine pears fill the square tray.
items.sentenceZh: 九个梨装满了方形托盘。
items.scene: Exactly nine whole pears are arranged in a clean three-by-three grid inside one square wooden tray viewed from a high angle. Every pear is fully visible and separated from the others. No people, cut fruit, extra fruit, numerals or text.
items.altText: 方形木托盘中以三乘三整齐摆放着九个完整的梨。

items.sentenceEn: The low path is flooded; therefore, they use the raised path.
items.sentenceZh: 低处小路被淹，因此他们走高架小路。
items.scene: In one continuous wetland scene, a low footpath is visibly flooded and impassable, so exactly two adult hikers turn away from it and continue safely along a raised dry boardwalk toward the same destination. Their glance back at the flooded route clearly links cause and consequence. No signs or arrows.
items.altText: 低处小路被水淹没，两名徒步者因此转而走向同一目的地的干燥高架栈道。

items.sentenceEn: She will conduct the chamber orchestra.
items.sentenceZh: 她将指挥室内乐团。
items.scene: One adult conductor faces a small chamber orchestra of exactly six adult musicians and actively guides their timing with a baton and expressive free hand. The musicians watch her while playing strings and woodwinds, making the act of conduct unmistakable. Blank music pages, no audience.
items.altText: 一名指挥用指挥棒和手势引导六名室内乐团演奏者。

items.sentenceEn: The host will announce the winner.
items.sentenceZh: 主持人将宣布获胜者。
items.scene: At a small community craft exhibition, one adult host opens a sealed envelope and speaks into a microphone to announce the winner. Exactly three adult finalists wait nearby; one begins to react with delighted surprise as the audience turns toward that person. No readable names, banners or awards text.
items.altText: 社区展览主持人打开信封对着麦克风宣布结果，一名入围者惊喜地作出反应。

items.sentenceEn: They have a thoughtful conversation over tea.
items.sentenceZh: 他们边喝茶边进行深入交谈。
items.scene: Exactly two adults sit facing each other across a small café table with two cups of tea. One speaks with an open hand while the other listens attentively and prepares to respond, with mutual eye contact and relaxed posture showing a balanced conversation rather than a lecture.
items.altText: 两名成年人隔着小桌面对面交谈，一人表达、一人专注倾听。
